about: Where an objective is done, or where the arrow leads for a quest's giver or ender, anchored on the quest (never a line). forge-writer applies each record to the guides it writes, every build; forge data check-corrections checks this file; FORGE.md, Fixing a generated guide, has the format. objective: the objective's number (as in `quest Q.N`), "giver" or "ender". at: { map, x, y, frame }; path: { map, frame, points } for a target that walks a road (a loop of gotos before the goal); write: true gives the objective its own goal line from the data before the quest's bare complete. A record with faction (Alliance or Horde) holds for that side's routes only. Each record has a note, its source ({ kind, ref }, the kinds of forever-db/README.md) and its issue or pr.

places.note: Blisters on the Land: the Fen Creepers are hunted in the Sundown Marsh waterways, not the few by Rethiel the Greenwarden. In game the reporter ran out of creepers at the spot by the giver and found enough at 24.46,33.18; 8 of the 19 Fen Creeper spawns lie within 300 yd of it (18.5-27.4, 27.7-39.2), against 6 scattered over the east of the zone.
Betrayed: the arrow leads to Magus Rimtori's camp, the quest's discovery objective, once both kill objectives are credited.
Scouring the Desert: the arrow leads to the Horde Silithyst delivery point.

Desperate Times: Ayessa Dawnsinger, west of town. The data has her for the other faction only, so she gets no goal line of her own (a kill would read as an elite to fight): the quest's complete leads there.
